name: video-metrics
check: test -e tools/video-metrics.py || { echo 'error: tools/video-metrics.py: not written'; exit 1; }; timeout 120 python3 -m unittest tools/test_video_metrics.py > /tmp/vm-check.out 2>&1; grep -q '^OK' /tmp/vm-check.out || { grep -E 'Error|FAIL|assert|line [0-9]+' /tmp/vm-check.out | head -30 | sed 's|^|error: tools/video-metrics.py: |'; exit 1; }

name: video-compare
check: test -e tools/video-compare.py || { echo 'error: tools/video-compare.py: not written'; exit 1; }; timeout 180 python3 -m unittest tools/test_video_compare.py > /tmp/vc-check.out 2>&1; grep -q '^OK' /tmp/vc-check.out || { grep -E 'Error|FAIL|assert|line [0-9]+|!=' /tmp/vc-check.out | head -30 | sed 's|^|error: tools/video-compare.py: |'; exit 1; }
